summary: Virginia National Bankshares Corporation filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing that on October 6, 2026 its board authorized a share repurchase plan for up to $18.7 million of common stock, par value $2.50 per share, through October 5, 2027. Repurchases may occur in the open market, privately negotiated transactions or otherwise, structured within Rule 10b-18 pricing and volume limits, with possible Rule 10b5-1 plans. No price per share or premium was stated. The plan is discretionary and may be extended, modified, suspended or discontinued. Watch buyback pace versus capital and liquidity.
